discussion_comments.comment_body:
Correct — fixed in 354a81230.

`SecretVar.MarshalJSON` serializes to `{ value, ref, type }` (type ∈ `plain_text|env|vault`), so the `value/env_var/from_env`-only variant with `additionalProperties: false` would reject the exact shape the parser round-trips. Both `object_storage` blocks now mirror the repo's canonical secret-reference schema (`mcp_external_client_url`): `value`, `ref`, `type` (enum), `env_var`, `from_env`.

Verified against `Draft7Validator`: `{ "value": "", "ref": "vault.audit/bucket", "type": "vault" }` and `{ "value": "", "ref": "env.AK", "type": "env" }` now validate for bucket/creds, alongside plain-string and legacy `from_env` forms.
